# Runbook: rotating the Zendesk API token

The Zendesk API token expires every 90 days. Rotate it during business hours, since the support integration stops syncing while the old token is invalid.

Generate a new token in the Zendesk admin center under Apps and Integrations, then store it in Vault at secret/helpdesk/zendesk. Then run kubectl rollout restart deployment/support-sync and confirm that the next cron run at the top of the hour completes without errors.

If the worker logs a 401, check the token for a trailing space, re-enter it, and run the rollout command again.
